takes.h: Hodder & Stoughton plans special UK editions of the Talisman trilogy
takes.p: Lilja’s Library reports Hodder & Stoughton is releasing special editions of all three Talisman books by Stephen King and Peter Straub in December 2026, sold only through stephenkingbooks.co.uk to UK buyers. The first printing is 1,000 copies of each title, with foil-stamped wibalin cases, sprayed edges and designed endpapers.
